title: VIRTUAL SINGER Chapter1 Episode21 Painful Note

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu, are you sure you really should have sent everyone back like that?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We will. Thanks, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Now I can get back to searching for myself.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (There she goes writing her songs again.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She has sheet music scattered all around her.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And it all sounds so painful.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Mafuyu's music... I wonder if her feelings are really in it.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What's the matter, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Isn't that a song I wrote?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It is. Why do you look so surprised?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It just doesn't quite sound like what I wrote.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Everyone says my music sounds gloomy and dark, but when you sing it, it doesn't sound that way at all.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It still sounds lonely, but...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It gives me the impression that you want to be saved.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Saved?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That must mean you put those feelings into the music when you wrote it, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I put those feelings into the song?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. I simply sang the song the way you wrote it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If Miku sang it, maybe even that other song...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hey, Miku. Would you try singing that song from the other day?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How did that song sound to you, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: When I first heard it long ago, it sounded so warm. Now, however, I'm not sure.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That must mean this song is special to you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Special?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But, that song wasn't enough...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wasn't enough?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, never mind.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu, are you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She's gone back to her songs. She doesn't appear to be listening anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu, I hope one day you will discover why this song is so important to you.
